rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1 programs certified by an ACCME-accredited organization; ACCME-accredited medical education programs; internship/residency/fellowship, advanced-degree study or full-time research at AMA/AAMC/AOA-approved institutions (1 credit hour per full-time day); teaching; publishing/presenting; self-instruction media, reading journals/books, board exam preparation, quality-of-care/utilization review committees
rules.carryover: Not allowed: excess hours cannot be carried over to another two-year cycle.
rules.alternatives: Extension of time granted on written application if CME was missed because of illness, military service, medical or religious missionary activity, or residence in a foreign country.
rules.audit_note: Renewal form signed under penalty of perjury that CME for the two calendar years before renewal is complete; the Board may randomly audit.

topics.who: Physicians authorized to prescribe schedule II controlled substances with a valid DEA registration: opioid-, substance-use-disorder- or addiction-related CME

rules.notes: MD license renews every other year on or before the licensee's birthday (R4-16-201.1(A), A.R.S. § 32-1430(A)); CME counted over the two calendar years before renewal. Late renewal penalty $350. Renewal also asks if a Board training unit on the law was completed.

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 24 hours AOA Category 1-A (AOA-accredited sponsors); remainder any category incl. AMA PRA Category 1 from ACCME/AMA-accredited providers. Residency/internship/fellowship/preceptorship = 20 AOA 1-A hours per year
rules.alternatives: Waiver possible for disability, military service, absence from the US or circumstances beyond the licensee's control (request Oct 1 - Jan 30); extension to April 30 on request.
rules.audit_note: CME entered in the Licensee Portal; documentation (AOA/specialty board activity reports or certificates) required if randomly audited.

topics.who: All DOs, even without DEA registration or opioid prescribing (Board FAQ); opioid-related CME, AOA 1-A or AMA Category 1

rules.notes: DOs are licensed by the separate Arizona Board of Osteopathic Examiners (azdo.gov). Licenses renew every two years; Board says renew by December 31 (statute: on or before January 1). CME counted over the two calendar years before renewal.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: 20 CME credits, 12 of them AOA Category 1-A.
